ingredients.name: semi-sweet chocolate morsels or chocolate chips

steps.instruction: Cream 2 sticks of softened butter with 1 cup of granulated white sugar.
Add 1 cup of packed brown sugar and cream again.
Beat in 2 extra-large eggs and 1 teaspoon of vanilla extract.
Sift in 2 cups of all-purpose flour and 2 cups of oat flour.
Sift in 1/2 teaspoon of salt, 1 teaspoon baking powder and 1 teaspoon baking soda.
Stir in 2 cups of chocolate chips and 4 ounces of grated milk chocolate.
Stir in 3 cups of chopped nuts, if you like.
Roll the dough into balls and place them 2 inches apart on a cookie sheet.
Bake for 10 minutes, until golden brown.
steps.spoken: Bake for 10 minutes, or until golden brown. Baking times may vary.

steps.instruction: Let the cookies stand 1 minute, then move them to a plate or cooling sheet.
